name: Rose Lalonde
source:
A 13 year old girl and friend of John, Dave and Jade. She lives with her alcoholic mother in a large house in the woods. She is befriended in Volume 2 of Pesterquest.

Rose is a snarky and analytical girl with an interest in writing and magic - though she claims to hate wizards.
